question:
(i) Define electric flux through a plane surface.
(ii) Write its expression for a uniform electric field making an angle $\theta$ with the area vector.

options.A:
(i) Electric flux is the force acting on a charge through a surface
(ii) $\phi_E = ES\sin\theta$, unit $\text{N m C}^{-1}$
options.B:
(i) Electric flux is charge per unit area
(ii) $\phi_E = \vec{E}\times\vec{S}$, unit $\text{C m}^{-2}$
options.C:
(i) Electric flux measures the electric field passing through a surface
(ii) $\phi_E=\vec{E}\cdot\vec{S}=ES\cos\theta$, unit $\text{N m}^2\text{C}^{-1}$
options.D:
(i) Electric flux is the electric field at a point
(ii) $\phi_E=\frac{E}{S}$, unit $\text{N C}^{-1}$
